topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: Well, here I am, stuck with another one of these flower deliveries, no note, no nothing. Just a bundle of petals and leaves, as if that's supposed to make everything alright. What's the point, really? It's like half the effort, or even less. People send these things and think it solves all problems, answers all questions. It's just a momentary distraction, a temporary fix for something that likely needs a real conversation, real effort. And I'm left here, tidying up their mess, making sure everything is perfect, while the real issues just get swept under the rug. Flowers. Great. Another day in paradise.
